content: .{@-पदः@} .²1 a community, race, nation; <ls>Y. 1. 361</ls> <ab>v. l.</ab> .²2 a kingdom, an empire, an inhabited country; जनपदे न गदः पदमादधौ <ls>R. 9. 4</ls>; दाक्षिणात्ये जनपदे <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; <ls>Me. 48</ls>. .²3 the country (<ab>opp.</ab> the town पुर, नगर); जनपदवधूलोचनैः पीयमानः <ls>Me. 16</ls>. .²4 the people, subjects (<ab>opp.</ab> the sovereign); जनपदहितकर्ता त्यज्यते पार्थिवेन <ls>Pt. 1. 131</ls>. .²5 mankind. .²6 {%a.%} considering his subjects as authority; आपौरप्रकृतिजनपदो राजा <ls>Bhāg. 5. 4. 5</ls>.
